newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Tuesday June 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Tuesday June 10.

text.p: The following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.
* Prime minister Romano Prodi said European economic and monetary union (EMU) should be launched as soon as possible (all).

* Treasury minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi, attending a meeting of EU finance ministers, said no country wanted to delay the launch of European EMU but added that he agreed with France's emphasis on the need to create new jobs (all).

* Treasury minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said he would present a decree to the government in the next few days paving the way for privatisation of state controlled telecoms group STET by mid-October. Savings shares in both companies fell around 15 percent on the Milan stock exchange after the Italian Treasury said on Friday that savings shares in STET and telecoms operator Telecom Italia could not be converted into ordinary shares (all).

* Industry minister Pierluigi Bersani, attending the annual meeting of the Lombardy region industrialists' association Assolombarda, said reforms to the country's welfare state would proceed regardless of hard left Communist Refoundation's refusal to touch pension spending (all).

* Shares in Italy's largest listed food company Parmalat were temporarily suspended on the Milan bourse, then were marked down around five percent after it announced an accord to take over Canadian food group Ault Foods (all).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
